project.name: voxlblade
project.description: Web-based damage calculator and build optimizer for the Roblox game Voxel Blade. Simulates weapon stats, enchantments, perks, and game mechanics to compute damage output and compare builds.

nodes.name: mountRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Mount mount-rune damage definitions (Winter Woof, Slizard, Glacial Snapper) with per-hit M1/WA base damage, damage types, summon scalings, heals, guardbreak flags and cooldowns used by the damage engine.

nodes.name: procCoefficients.ts
nodes.summary: Lookup tables of M1/M2 and Weapon Art proc coefficients per weapon type plus a default fallback coefficient (1.0) for anything not listed.

nodes.name: statboost.ts
nodes.summary: Registry of perk-driven stat boosts (Roaring Heads, Righted Wrongs, Weight Distribution, Brawny, etc.) that mutate a StatMap in a fixed execution order; exports applyStatBoostPerks to apply selected perks and round the result.

nodes.name: weapon base dmg.ts
nodes.summary: Static per-weapon-type base damage arrays for M1/M2 hits, including multi-hit objects, m1Finisher flags and the Rifle charge formula, consumed to compute per-hit weapon damage.

nodes.name: stat-conversions.ts
nodes.summary: Numeric constants for perk stat conversion rates (Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Frozen Heart, etc.) and stat subtractions (Roaring Heads, Lucky) used by the statboost.ts perk handlers.

nodes.name: dmgTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Damage-type computation interfaces (ComputedType, PerkOnHitDmg, ComputedHit) plus BADGE_CONFIG display metadata (colors, labels, tooltips) for the proc badges shown in calculator results.

nodes.name: enchantTooltip.ts
nodes.summary: Builds a multi-line tooltip string for an enchantment from its description, stat modifiers and effects via the exported getEnchantTooltipText helper.

nodes.name: engine.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module that re-exports the entire damage engine: data lookups (character/equipment/weapons), shrine, enchant, weapon, build and format modules.

nodes.name: character.ts
nodes.summary: Typed access to race, guild and perk JSON data with lookup maps, plus helpers for resolving guild ranks and detecting the Monk guild.

nodes.name: equipment.ts
nodes.summary: Typed access to ring, rune, enchantment and armor JSON data with lookup maps, armor part normalization (shared parts merged into each part) and armor slot-support helpers.

nodes.name: weapons.ts
nodes.summary: Typed access to blade, handle, glove and essence JSON weapon data with per-item lookup maps used when computing weapon stats and scalings.

nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: Svelte writable/derived stores holding the build state with debounced localStorage persistence and mutation actions (setEnchantment, setGuild, moveArmorSlot, moveRingSlot, clearBuild); the derived result store runs calcBuild for live damage output.

nodes.name: finalizeRounding
nodes.summary: Rounds percent-type stats to two decimal places and drops zero-valued entries from the resulting StatMap.

nodes.name: applyStatBoostPerks
nodes.summary: Applies each selected perk handler in a fixed execution order to a copy of the stats and returns the rounded final StatMap.

nodes.name: getEnchantTooltipText
nodes.summary: Formats an enchantment's description, stat modifier lines and effect lines into a single multi-line tooltip string.

nodes.name: getGuildRank
nodes.summary: Returns the guild rank definition that matches the given rank number, or undefined when none matches.

nodes.name: isMonkGuild
nodes.summary: Returns true when the given guild name is the Monk guild, used by the store to switch between regular and Monk weapon sets.

nodes.name: getArmorPart
nodes.summary: Looks up a normalized armor part by armor name and slot type, merging shared-part fields into each part.

nodes.name: armorSupportsSlot
nodes.summary: Returns whether the named armor has a part of the given slot type, used by the store to validate armor slot moves.

nodes.name: loadBuild
nodes.summary: Reads and parses the saved build from localStorage, falling back to the default build on parse errors or missing data.

nodes.name: setEnchantment
nodes.summary: Sets one enchantment cell in a slot and applies exclusive-enchant slot enforcement to the slot's enchantments.

nodes.name: swapEnchantments
nodes.summary: Swaps the three enchantments between two slots of the build state.

nodes.name: clearBuild
nodes.summary: Resets the build store to the default build state.

nodes.name: setGuild
nodes.summary: Updates the guild and rank in the build store, forcing race to DRAGON BLOODED for Draconic and switching weapon slots between regular and Monk equipment.

nodes.name: moveArmorSlot
nodes.summary: Moves or clones an armor between helmet/chestplate/leggings slots after validating slot type support, also swapping upgrade levels between the slots.

nodes.name: canArmorMoveToSlot
nodes.summary: Returns whether the named armor can occupy the given armor slot based on its part types.

nodes.name: moveRingSlot
nodes.summary: Moves or clones a ring between the ring and infusion ring slots, carrying the upgrade level across.

nodes.name: DoTDamage.ts
nodes.summary: Damage-over-time calculation module for Bleed, Burn, and Poison debuffs. Provides base damage, potency multipliers, tick damage, and builder-to-game potency conversion, including Endless Despair modifier handling.

nodes.name: getDotBase
nodes.summary: Computes the flat base DoT damage from infliction potency: 1.75 x (1 + potency/1.1).

nodes.name: getDotPotencyMult
nodes.summary: Returns the DoT potency multiplier (1+potency)^(1+min(1,potency)), capped at exponent 2 once potency reaches 1.0.

nodes.name: toGamePotency
nodes.summary: Converts a builder-display perk value to the game-internal potency (x0.1 per display point).

nodes.name: calcDotDisplayPotency
nodes.summary: Computes the effective displayed DoT potency, applying the Endless Despair 35%-per-stack modifier when present.

nodes.name: HealBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Aggregates all heal-scaling sources (level, Emotional, Heal Boost, Oceans Rage, Vampire Sunlight, draconic infusion) into a final heal multiplier for perk, rune, and weapon-art healing.

nodes.name: calculateHealBoost
nodes.summary: Iterates the heal-scaling source definitions against a context and returns the final heal multiplier with a per-source breakdown.

nodes.name: Runebasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Rune damage definitions and helpers covering rune skills such as Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, and Rocky Tail. Computes rune heal scaling through the shared heal-boost engine and carries slider and shield configs.

nodes.name: calculateRuneHealScaling
nodes.summary: Computes a rune's heal-scaling multiplier by delegating to the shared heal-boost calculator; returns 1.0 for non-heal runes.

nodes.name: SummonData.ts
nodes.summary: Defines summon stat-scaling helpers and static summon data (Mage Bomber, Blessedling) with attack stats, plus a map from weapon-art summons to summon definitions and summon-perk metadata.

nodes.name: calcSummonStat
nodes.summary: Scales a summon base stat by summon-boost percentage and player level relative to the max level.

nodes.name: calcMaxSummonCount
nodes.summary: Computes the maximum summon count from the base cap of 15 plus Swarm perk stacks.

nodes.name: cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Cooldown reduction data per perk, mapping perks like Caster, Whirlwind, Poison Acceleration, and Voltaic Body to rune/weapon-art CDR percentages, multipliers, and set cooldowns.

nodes.name: draconicColorEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines per-draconic-color attack modifiers (damage, speed, knockback, stun) and a helper to look up the damage multiplier for a given draconic color.

nodes.name: getDraconicColorDmgMultiplier
nodes.summary: Returns the damage multiplier for a draconic color from the attack-stats map, defaulting to 1.

nodes.name: raceEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Race passive conditionals (e.g. Human below 50% HP gaining damage boost and flat DR) plus Ork tenacity buff-counting helpers.

nodes.name: getActiveRaceEffect
nodes.summary: Returns the race conditional effect matching the race name whose HP gate is currently active.

nodes.name: getOrkTenacityBuffs
nodes.summary: Filters out debuffs, self-debuffs, neutral buffs, and duplicates to return the unique buffs counted for Ork tenacity.

nodes.name: calcOrkTenacityBonus
nodes.summary: Computes the Ork tenacity bonus as 10% per unique active buff.

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export module that aggregates all game constant submodules under lib/constants.

nodes.name: dot-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized DoT tuning constants: base damage, infliction divisor, potency power cap, rounding factor, and builder-to-game conversion.

nodes.name: rune-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Base damage, hit-count, and scaling constants for rune skills including Rocky Tail, Caci, Beenade, Boostshroom, and Ancient Cleric.

nodes.name: toast.ts
nodes.summary: Svelte store managing transient toast notifications with time-based auto-dismissal.

nodes.name: addToast
nodes.summary: Adds a toast to the store and schedules its automatic removal after the configured duration.

nodes.name: removeToast
nodes.summary: Removes a toast from the store by its id.

nodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines type-specific damage boost definitions (Glyph Conduit, Rage, Photosynthesis, Hex Shield) and calcTypedDmgBoosts, which computes damage/heal multipliers per damage type from perks and active buffs.

nodes.name: calcTypedDmgBoosts
nodes.summary: Iterates typed damage-boost definitions, evaluates each perk- or buff-driven condition, and aggregates per-type damage multipliers plus a heal multiplier into a TypedDmgBoostResult.

nodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
nodes.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, part names) are satisfied for a given build. Exports checkWA for a pass/fail check and getUnmetReqs for human-readable unmet-requirement lists.

nodes.name: passesAtLeastOneScaling
nodes.summary: Returns true if the weapon art's atLeastOneScaling requirement is satisfied by any matching scaling key.

nodes.name: buildUnmetScalingReqs
nodes.summary: Produces human-readable strings listing unmet scaling thresholds, including a combined 'at least one of' alternative when no alternative scaling is met.

nodes.name: checkWA
nodes.summary: Boolean check that all weapon-art requirements (monk/guild, both-parts, weapon type, scaling, stats) are met for the given build.

nodes.name: getUnmetReqs
nodes.summary: Returns a list of readable unmet-requirement strings for a weapon art against the given build stats and weapon.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts
nodes.summary: Static data catalog of all weapon arts with per-art requirements, damage type, scaling, cooldown, hit breakdowns and monk flags. Drives requirement checks and weapon-art damage-type resolution in the engine.

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Central constants for damage-type metadata: labels/colors, defense-tracked types, inheritance rules (air/earth to physical, fire/water/hex/holy to magic), priority ordering and canonical type lists.

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves final damage-type distributions: merges weapon-art damage types with bonuses, applies Fire-Air (Echo Incineration) and Air-to-Magic (Spirit Winds) conversions, and parses damage-type strings including 'Highest damage type'.

nodes.name: resolveDamageTypes
nodes.summary: Merges damage-type bonuses into a base type distribution, rounding each value to 4 decimals.

nodes.name: applyFireAirConversion
nodes.summary: Converts 50% of Fire and Air damage into each other, implementing the Echo Incineration mechanic.

nodes.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
nodes.summary: Parses a weapon art's damageType string ('Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or literal type percentages) into a damage-type map.

nodes.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Combines weapon-art damage-type resolution with damage-type bonuses to produce the final type distribution.

nodes.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
nodes.summary: Converts a fraction of Air damage to Magic (Spirit Winds) before optionally applying Echo Incineration and the Dark Magic hex bonus.

nodes.name: _utils.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny rounding helpers round2 and round4 used throughout the engine to keep floating-point results consistent.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build pipeline: accumulates stats/perks from all equipment slots, finalizes perks, computes CDR, boosts, crit, buffs and weapon results, and returns the assembled BuildResult via calcBuild.

nodes.name: calcCDR
nodes.summary: Computes rune and weapon-art cooldown-reduction multipliers with step-by-step breakdowns from perks, race modifiers, rune filters and toggles.

nodes.name: calcBoosts
nodes.summary: Builds the damage-multiplier map from level, boost definitions (perk- or calcFn-driven) and race effects, returning the total damage multiplier and entries.

nodes.name: accumulateMonkWeapon
nodes.summary: Adds monk glove and essence stats/perks with shrine scaling and monk-rank bonuses to the accumulating build state.

nodes.name: accumulateStandardWeapon
nodes.summary: Adds blade and handle stats/perks (optionally shrine-scaled) to the accumulating build state.

nodes.name: processEnchantedSlot
nodes.summary: Applies enchantments to a single named equipment slot (ring/rune) and merges the resulting stats and perks.

nodes.name: accumulateEquipment
nodes.summary: Sums stats and perks across race, guild/rank, armor, ring/rune, weapon and infusion slots for the build.

nodes.name: finalizePerks
nodes.summary: Cleans the raw perk map, applies Perk Effectiveness/Cursed multipliers, folds Buckler into Parry and grants potency-perk contributions from tagged perks.

nodes.name: applyGladiatorialRage
nodes.summary: Adds armor penetration equal to the highest offensive stat divided by 15 when Gladiatorial Rage is present.

nodes.name: deriveResults
nodes.summary: Computes final stats, CDR, crit, buffs, weapon damage-type distribution and boosts, then assembles the complete BuildResult for a build state.

nodes.name: calcBuild
nodes.summary: Entry point that accumulates equipment, finalizes perks and derives the full BuildResult from a BuildState.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export of engine data modules (character, equipment, weapons) exposing item registries and getters such as getBlade, getHandle, getGlove, getEnchant and getPerk.

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Applies enchantments to equipment slots: stat-selector transformations, direct stat modifiers, upgrade application, perk-effectiveness scaling and infusion; also enforces exclusive-enchant slot rules.

nodes.name: applyModsToKey
nodes.summary: Accumulates a list of stat modifiers into multiplier and additive buckets for a single stat key.

nodes.name: applyModsWhere
nodes.summary: Applies stat modifiers to all stat keys whose current value passes a predicate, used for enchant stat selectors like Restored/Flawless.

nodes.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
nodes.summary: Two-phase application of an enchant stack to an item's stats/perks: selector transforms, upgrade, direct modifiers, perk modifiers and effect perks.

nodes.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
nodes.summary: Multiplies all non-exempt perk amounts by combined Perk Effectiveness and Cursed stack multipliers.

nodes.name: applyInfusion
nodes.summary: Applies infusion by scaling all base stats to 50% and carrying base perks through unchanged.

nodes.name: isExclusiveEnchant
nodes.summary: Returns whether an enchantment has exclusive stacking behavior.

nodes.name: enforceEnchantSlot
nodes.summary: Deduplicates enchant selections and keeps only the first exclusive enchant, returning a valid 3-slot selection.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting helpers for displaying stat values with signs/percentages and converting camelCase keys to human-readable labels.

nodes.name: formatStat
nodes.summary: Formats a stat value with sign, optional percent suffix and trimmed decimals.

nodes.name: formatLabel
nodes.summary: Converts a camelCase key into a spaced, capitalized human-readable label.

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shrine tier multipliers and applies shrine scaling to weapon part stats and scalings.

nodes.name: applyShrineToScalings
nodes.summary: Multiplies all weapon-part scalings by the shrine multiplier for the part's tier.

nodes.name: applyShrineToStats
nodes.summary: Multiplies all stats by the shrine multiplier for a tier, rounding results to 2 decimals.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Computes weapon results for standard and monk weapons: merges blade/handle (or glove/essence) damage types, scalings, stats and perks, resolves weapon type with perk overrides, and applies shrine and monk-rank bonuses.

nodes.name: checkHybrid
nodes.summary: Detects a hybrid weapon where two parts have non-overlapping scaling sets.

nodes.name: resolveWeaponType
nodes.summary: Resolves the final weapon type from handle/blade types, applying perk-driven overrides such as Kama Blades, Dual Wielding, Lance and Saw Stance.

nodes.name: resolveMonkWeaponType
nodes.summary: Resolves the monk weapon type from essence/glove types with Saw Heart and Locked And Loaded overrides.

nodes.name: extractDamageAndScalings
nodes.summary: Extracts damage-type, scaling and stat data from a weapon part's stats object.

nodes.name: mergePartPerks
nodes.summary: Merges perk amounts and attack speeds from both weapon parts into a combined map.

nodes.name: mergeScalingsAndStats
nodes.summary: Applies shrine scaling to both parts, detects hybrid mode, merges scalings/stats and rounds combined stats.

nodes.name: buildWeaponResult
nodes.summary: Assembles the full WeaponResult from merged part data, resolved weapon type and damage types.

nodes.name: calcWeaponGeneric
nodes.summary: Shared driver for standard and monk weapons that extracts, merges and builds the WeaponResult.

nodes.name: applyMonkStatBonus
nodes.summary: Recomputes a monk weapon part's stats including the monk-rank bonus and patches the result's stats, final and raw fields.

nodes.name: calcWeapon
nodes.summary: Public entry that computes a WeaponResult for a blade+handle pair, optionally shrine-active.

nodes.name: calcMonkWeapon
nodes.summary: Public entry that computes a WeaponResult for monk glove+essence, adding monk-rank stat bonuses.

nodes.name: debuffCombatEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS, a map of debuffs (Weakness, Shatter, Sticky, Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, Hypnotized) to combat-effect callbacks that compute damage multipliers, defense reductions and per-type damage multipliers from potency.

nodes.name: defensivePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the defensive perk source table (Barbskin, Stoneskin, Adaptive Plate, Protector Spirit, Valor, Carapace, Cursed Bark, etc.) with DR-per-stack values and activation conditions, plus functions to resolve active DR sources for a build context and compute the defensive potency multiplier.

nodes.name: draconicBuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Generates Draconic guild buffs and debuffs for the Draconic Infusion rune and the Dragon Claw / Dragon Bubble abilities, with per-color (air, fire, hex, holy, water, earth) effects and potency/duration multipliers driven by the Draconic Blood perk.

nodes.name: debuff-effects.ts
nodes.summary: Small set of shared constants for debuff combat-effect math: the Sticky damage multiplier and the Despair display/damage coefficients used by debuffCombatEffects.

nodes.name: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Catalog of roughly 60 tuning constants for perk mechanics including crit damage, frostbite and sunburn scaling, curse rip, true balance, toxin transfer, void rage, draconic blood and other per-stack percentage values.

nodes.name: dmgTypeBonuses.ts
nodes.summary: Engine module that accumulates per-damage-type percentage bonuses contributed by perks (Void Rage, Channeled Weapon, Emotional, Draconic Blood), including dynamic effective-potency calculation for Draconic Infusion, while honoring no-proc exemptions and perk exclusion sets.

nodes.name: getActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.summary: Evaluates the defensive perk source table against a combat context (HP fill, darkness, rage, mount, shield, debuff count) and returns the active damage-reduction sources with their defPct values.

nodes.name: calcDefensivePotencyMult
nodes.summary: Computes the defensive potency multiplier from Bastion Bless stacks and holy Draconic Infusion potency scaling.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionPotMult
nodes.summary: Returns the Draconic Infusion potency multiplier for a given Draconic Blood perk amount.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionDurMult
nodes.summary: Returns the Draconic Infusion duration multiplier for a given Draconic Blood perk amount.

nodes.name: getEffectiveDraconicInfusionPotency
nodes.summary: Returns the effective Draconic Infusion potency after running the infusion buff through applyBuffPerkModifiers, or 0 when no infusion buff applies.

nodes.name: getDraconicInfusionBuff
nodes.summary: Builds the Draconic Infusion GrantedBuff for Draconic guild members with an infusion rune, including color-specific effect descriptions and an optional fire Burn application.

nodes.name: getDraconicAbilityDebuffs
nodes.summary: Builds debuff lists for the Dragon Claw and Dragon Bubble abilities, granting hex-pool debuffs plus a guaranteed Weakness, or a fire Burn, depending on the draconic color.

nodes.name: buildDmgTypeBonuses
nodes.summary: Iterates perk damage-type bonus definitions to accumulate per-type percent bonuses, using dynamic effective potency for Draconic Blood and honoring no-proc exemptions, conditions and exclusion sets.

nodes.name: enemyHpEffects.ts
nodes.summary: Defines enemy-HP-gated perk effects (e.g. Mycotic Bloom) that either apply a debuff while the enemy is above/below an HP threshold or boost a DoT type. Exports helpers that resolve which enemy-HP effects are currently active for a build.

nodes.name: getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs
nodes.summary: Returns the debuffs (e.g. Slowness) granted by enemy-HP-gated perks that are active given the equipped perk amounts, enemy HP fill percent, and already-active debuff names.

nodes.name: getEnemyHpDotMultiplier
nodes.summary: Computes the multiplicative DoT damage boost from enemy-HP-gated effects (e.g. +25% Poison damage per stack below 50% HP) for a given DoT type.

nodes.name: game.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for core game constants: max level, defaults for HP fill, the base HP formula (calcBaseMaxHP), and UI timing constants such as save debounce and undo window.

nodes.name: calcBaseMaxHP
nodes.summary: Computes a character's base max HP at a given level using a flat base plus per-level percentage scaling, rounded to an integer.

nodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Curated table of numeric base damage, heal, and scaling coefficient constants for many perks and weapon arts (Dragon Claw, Springblast, spirits, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, etc.) consumed by the damage engine.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: LocalStorage persistence contracts: storage keys, build-state defaults, and save/encode maps that compress build fields to short keys, plus build slot and confirmation timeout limits.

nodes.name: weaponConditionalBoosts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines weapon-conditional perk boosts (Aggressive Personality, Piercer) with per-weapon-type multipliers scoped to M1/M2 finisher hits, plus a lookup that aggregates matching boosts into a combined rounded multiplier.

nodes.name: getWeaponConditionalBoost
nodes.summary: Looks up conditional perk boosts matching the weapon type and hit scope, multiplies per-perk multipliers for equipped perks, and returns the rounded combined multiplier with matched perk labels.

nodes.name: crit.ts
nodes.summary: Core crit engine computing natural/extra crit chance, proc-coefficient scaled chances, and crit damage multiplier from perk sources (Dexterity, elemental boosts, Thief Training, Venom Eater, etc.), including Primal gating and full breakdown reporting.

nodes.name: calcCrit
nodes.summary: Main exported crit calculator that aggregates natural and extra crit sources, applies proc coefficients and Primal division, combines independent crit chances, and builds crit chance/damage breakdowns plus the combined-chance formula.

nodes.name: calcElementalBoost
nodes.summary: Helper computing an elemental perk's crit contribution by scaling the stat value with a per-perk multiplier multiplied by equipped perk stacks.

nodes.name: defense.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves defense sources into flat and percent defense multipliers, converting them into effective damage multipliers and true DR percentages, and maps damage types to the armor stat keys that grant their base defense.

nodes.name: resolveDefenseSources
nodes.summary: Splits defense sources into flat and percent groups, computes each source's rounded damage multiplier and true DR percentage, and returns combined percent, flat, and final multipliers.

nodes.name: calcBaseArmorDefPct
nodes.summary: Sums the armor defense stat percentages contributing to a given damage type using the DEF_GROUP mapping and rounds the total.

nodes.name: Deploy static content to Pages
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that checks out the repository, installs dependencies, builds the Vite/Svelte project via `npm run build`, and deploys the resulting ./dist artifact to GitHub Pages on pushes to main or manual dispatch.

nodes.name: .fallowrc.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analysis configuration that sets source entry points (src/index, src/main), duplicate-detection thresholds (minOccurrences 3), a warn rule for unused dependencies, and per-file ignoreExports lists for Svelte components and game-data constants that fallow would otherwise flag.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent Context file describing the voxlblade-builder project: the Svelte 5 + Vite + TypeScript stack, source layout, development workflow (install/dev/test/build/lint/format), testing conventions, and AI agent interaction guidelines.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Stock create-vite README for the Svelte + TypeScript template, covering recommended IDE setup, why plain Vite was chosen over SvelteKit, and technical decisions around global.d.ts, allowJs, and HMR state preservation.

nodes.name: build-decode.txt
nodes.summary: Two-line scratch artifact holding a corrupted/truncated JSON snapshot of a decoded in-game build (race ORK, class Monk, weapons, runes, and essence parts) used as a manual decode scratchpad.

nodes.name: build-decode2.json
nodes.summary: Invalid/truncated JSON file (1 line) containing the same corrupted decoded build snapshot as build-decode.txt; not machine-parseable, kept as a working artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Contents are truncated and not valid JSON (parse fails); kept as a scratch artifact.

nodes.name: fallow-output.json
nodes.summary: Fallow dead-code analysis report (schema v7) recording 28 total issues: 1 unused file, 23 unused exports, 2 unused types, and 2 duplicate exports, with entry-point sources and guided next-step fallow commands.

nodes.name: fallow-security.json
nodes.summary: Fallow security analysis report with security_findings (e.g. a low-severity tainted-sink / CWE-79 finding in src/DidYouMean.svelte writing to innerHTML), an attack-surface summary, and unresolved-callee diagnostics.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry page for the VoxlBlade Builder app: loads Font Awesome from CDN and mounts the Svelte application by loading /src/main.ts into the #app container.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest for voxlblade with scripts (dev, build, preview, check, test) and dependencies including Svelte 5, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Vitest, fallow, Playwright, vite-plugin-pwa, rollup-plugin-visualizer, and @vercel/analytics.

nodes.name: stats-data.json
nodes.summary: Single-line rollup-plugin-visualizer output tree (JSON) of the production bundle, enumerating rolldown/vite runtime chunks, Svelte internal modules, and app modules with per-module sizes and UIDs.
nodes.languageNotes: Entire file is one minified JSON line; parseable by the visualizer tooling.

nodes.name: ts-errors.txt
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file (0 non-empty lines) apparently intended to capture TypeScript compiler error output; currently contains no diagnostics.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Svelte app extending @tsconfig/svelte, targeting ES2023 with svelte and vite/client types, checkJs enabled, and src/**/*.{ts,js,svelte} included for svelte-check.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript config that simply extends ./tsconfig.app.json so editor tooling picks up the app typechecking settings.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the Node/build side covering vite.config.ts with bundler module resolution, node types, noEmit, and strict linting flags (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters).

nodes.name: vercel.json
nodes.summary: Vercel deployment configuration that runs npm run build, serves the dist output as a Vite app, and sets immutable long-term Cache-Control headers for /assets, plus must-revalidate policies for /sw.js and /index.html.

nodes.name: armors.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module listing the armor sets available in Voxel Blade. Each entry defines a shared stat block (elemental boosts, defenses, tenacity), an attached perk with amount, and the Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings parts (including standalone single-part items), which the equipment engine consumes to compute equipped armor effects.

nodes.name: blades.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module cataloguing blade heads across tiers 1-5. Each entry carries tier, attack speed, damage-type weights and scaling coefficients, blade type (Small/Medium/Heavy/Hammer), and any perks granted, feeding the weapon engine's blade lookup.

nodes.name: enchantments.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module defining weapon/armor enchantments in unAscended and Ascended categories. Each entry specifies stacking behaviour (exclusive vs multi) plus stat/effect modifications such as multipliers and additions, some with acquisition notes (mob modifiers, Lord Frogg's Cavern).

nodes.name: essences.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module listing essence variants of weapon parts across tiers 1-5. Each entry mirrors blade-like stats, scaling coefficients, essence type, and granted perks, consumed by the weapon engine's getEssence lookup.

nodes.name: gloves.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module describing gloves (and shield-type items) for the weapon slot. Entries define tier, attack speed, scaling stats, perks, and glove type, including unique 'Spirit' perks per glove, feeding the weapon engine's getGlove lookup.

nodes.name: guilds.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module defining playable guilds (Gladiator, Cursed, Cleric, Scholar, Knight, Thief, Draconic, Monk, Vampire) with three progression ranks each. Every rank lists per-rank stat bonuses and granted perks, which the character engine uses to apply guild effects such as the Monk check.

nodes.name: handles.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module cataloguing handle parts (Medium/Long Handle and Pole) across tiers 1-5. Each entry defines attack speed, scaling stats, handle type, and granted perks, feeding the weapon engine's getHandle lookup.

nodes.name: perks.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module holding the full perk encyclopedia (3689 lines). Each entry pairs a perk name with a gameplay description and functional tags (Offensive, Defensive, Buff, Debuff, Armor, Weapon, Rune, etc.) used to classify and validate perks across the character engine.

nodes.name: races.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module defining the ten playable races and their passive abilities. Entries include passive text plus optional mechanical modifiers such as global armor penetration, stat modifiers, and cooldown reductions, consumed by the character engine's race lookup.

nodes.name: rings.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module listing equippable rings with flavor text, upgrade level, stat bonuses, and an attached perk with amount. The equipment engine's getRing lookup consumes these entries for the ring slots.

nodes.name: runes.json
nodes.summary: JSON game-data module defining active ability runes with descriptions, stat bonuses, cooldowns, and optional linked perks. The equipment engine's getRune lookup consumes these entries for rune slot selection.

nodes.name: .slim/deepwork/ui-upgrade.md
nodes.summary: Planning document for a phased UI refactor of the voxlblade app, proposing extraction of the repetitive modal system, a toast/notification system, the app header, and consolidation of CSS design tokens into app.css to shrink App.svelte.

nodes.name: analyze-mounticon.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone debug script that reads src/MountIcon.svelte and prints the length plus first/last chunks of its SVG path data so the mount icon shape can be inspected.

nodes.name: decode_full.mjs
nodes.summary: Standalone debug build decoder that loads all game data JSON files and reconstructs final equipment stats by applying upgrade scaling, enchantment selectors, shrines and infusions, mirroring engine constants for validation.

nodes.name: applyUpgrade
nodes.summary: Scales positive stat values up by 1 + level*0.1 and negative values down by the same factor to model weapon upgrade tiers.

nodes.name: computeSelectorBaseMult
nodes.summary: Iterates enchantment names in reverse and computes the base stat multiplier contributed by positive, negative and defense stat selectors.

nodes.name: applyDirectEnchantModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies flat stat modifiers from equipped enchantments on top of the selector-derived base multipliers for a slot.

nodes.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a full enchantment application for one equipment slot by chaining selector base multipliers, upgrade scaling and direct modifier application.

nodes.name: finalizePerks
nodes.summary: Merges raw perk entries collected from equipped items and enchantments into a final perk map, exempting internal keys and converting potion-style entries.

nodes.name: docs/ONBOARDING.md
nodes.summary: Onboarding guide describing voxlblade's architecture layers (config, source, data, engine, modals, stores), the damage calculation pipeline, component hierarchy and a file map with complexity hotspots.

nodes.name: src/app.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet defining the dark-theme design tokens (colors, surfaces, fonts, radii, shadows, z-indexes) and draconic theme variables consumed by every Svelte component.

nodes.name: src/App.svelte
nodes.summary: Root Svelte component orchestrating the entire app: build-state editors (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon, enchant selection with drag-and-drop), and the damage analyzer, buff list, level bar, emotional tracker and build saves.

nodes.name: src/BuffList.svelte
nodes.summary: Displays and manages the active buff/debuff list for the current build, deriving buffs from equipped items, potions, perks and weapon arts, applying warding multipliers and letting the user toggle effects.

nodes.name: src/BuildSaves.svelte
nodes.summary: Implements build save/load/export/import with localStorage slots, a search index over saved items, confirmation modals and toast feedback.

nodes.name: src/CdrStepsCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Renders cooldown reduction as a chain of multiplication steps (rune or weapon-art breakdown) with the final floor and CD minimum cap applied, including an optional set-bonus override.

nodes.name: src/CritIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Tiny SVG component rendering a gradient crit star/bolt glyph at a configurable size with a unique per-instance gradient id.

nodes.name: src/data/draconicRunes.ts
nodes.summary: Data/calculation module for the Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion buff systems, providing apply/get helpers that modify or read per-element damage-type bonuses based on rune stacks and infusion potency.

nodes.name: applyDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Adds 0.05 * stack count to the current draconic element's damage type in a copy of the damage map when rune stacks are positive.

nodes.name: getDraconicRunesBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the bonus damage contribution from Draconic Runes as a {element: bonus} map, empty when no stacks are active.

nodes.name: applyDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Adds the infusion potency to the draconic element's damage type in a copy of the damage map when the infusion buff is active.

nodes.name: getDragonInfusionBonus
nodes.summary: Returns the damage bonus from Dragon Infusion as a {element: potency} map, empty when the buff is inactive.

nodes.name: applyDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Exported helper that applies both Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion bonuses onto a damage-type map in sequence.

nodes.name: getDraconicBonuses
nodes.summary: Exported helper that combines the read-style bonuses from both Draconic Runes and Dragon Infusion into a single element-to-bonus map.

nodes.name: src/data/potions.ts
nodes.summary: Static data module listing the potion options (Rage Potion and Poison Potion) with descriptions and colors, plus a name-to-potion lookup map.

nodes.name: src/data/selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.summary: Defines self-damage perk metadata (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier, Steam Powered) and calcSelfDamage, which computes self-inflicted damage by type with DR, multi-target falloff and flat proc handling.

nodes.name: calcSelfDamage
nodes.summary: Computes total and per-type self damage for a perk given its damage percentage, defense multipliers, enemy count (harmonic falloff) and hit count, supporting flat proc-based damage.

nodes.name: src/data/stanceOverlays.ts
nodes.summary: Defines stance-overlay rules (Blaster Ring, Locked And Loaded, Cosmic Ray, Mine) that map build conditions to a resolved weapon-art stance type, exported via resolveStanceOverlay.

nodes.name: resolveStanceOverlay
nodes.summary: Returns the first matching stance overlay result (type and M2 behavior) for a given build context, or null when no overlay applies.

nodes.name: src/DidYouMean.svelte
nodes.summary: Shows 'Did you mean?' suggestion chips when a search returns no exact results, dispatching the selected label and highlighting matched text parts.

nodes.name: src/DmgTotalTooltip.svelte
nodes.summary: Tooltip component rendering a per-hit damage breakdown grouped by damage type with an animated pie chart, badge configs per entry and percentage share of the hit total.

nodes.name: src/DraconicAbilityStats.svelte
nodes.summary: Small stat display panel for draconic abilities showing damage type, scaling, poise damage and optional holy/water heal rows.

nodes.name: src/EmotionalTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: UI control for selecting the character's emotional state (buff/debuff/both) via quick buttons and a segmented slider, writing the selection into the build store and reflecting a disabled flag.

nodes.name: src/Highlight.svelte
nodes.summary: Utility component that splits text into highlighted/unhighlighted parts matching a query using highlightTextParts and renders matched segments inside a mark element.

nodes.name: src/LevelBar.svelte
nodes.summary: Interactive level and HP-fill editor synced to the build store and localStorage, computing effective max HP from protection (shield/negative) values and letting the user drag the HP bar.

nodes.name: src/lib/AppHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: App shell header with an animated Overview/Analyze tab navigation (including keyboard Tab switching) and hosting the BuildSaves component.

nodes.name: src/lib/constants/cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Constants module exporting cooldown-reduction tuning values (percentages, per-stack reductions, set bonuses) for various runes, weapon arts and set effects.

nodes.name: defensive.ts
nodes.summary: Exports numeric damage-reduction constants for defensive perks (Barb Skin, Stone Skin, Adaptive Plate, Valor, Vampire, Carapace, etc.) consumed by the damage engine's defensive calculations.

nodes.name: draconic-colors.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic color effect multipliers for fire, air, earth, water, and hex, covering speed, damage, knockback, stun, and cooldown modifiers.

nodes.name: draconic.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic infusion potency/duration multipliers and Dragon State HP/damage balance constants including Bastion blessing.

nodes.name: heals.ts
nodes.summary: Healing-related balance constants for crit healing (base, per-stack, holy boost divisor) and Ocean Song per-stack bonus.

nodes.name: constants/index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export aggregating all game constant modules (damage types, perks, boosts, draconic, thresholds, heals, defensive, etc.).

nodes.name: thresholds.ts
nodes.summary: Global balance thresholds: armor-pen branch cutoff, cooldown floor, and base critical damage percent.

nodes.name: wa-display.ts
nodes.summary: Maps weapon-art perk display names so perks like Weighty Slam, Guardian Spin, or Heat Drill render a friendlier label.

nodes.name: EnchantSelect.svelte
nodes.summary: Accessible custom dropdown/combobox for picking an enchantment with search, keyboard navigation, rAF-throttled positioning, and per-enchantment color dots.

nodes.name: engine/engine.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel module re-exporting the public damage-engine API from data, shrine, enchant, weapon, build, and format submodules.

nodes.name: Modal.svelte
nodes.summary: Reusable modal shell with overlay, focus trapping, focus-on-open, and shared modal-list/modal-item global styling used by all selection modals.

nodes.name: AccessorySelectModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting armor pieces, rings, runes, and infusions, showing effective boost computed against weapon scalings and Brawny conversion.

nodes.name: GuildModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting a guild and its rank, filtering by name/perk search and rendering rank stats and perk tags.

nodes.name: modals/index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export of the four selection modal components (Race, Guild, Accessory, WeaponPart).

nodes.name: RaceModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for selecting a race, listing passive description and stat modifiers for each option.

nodes.name: WeaponPartModal.svelte
nodes.summary: Modal for picking weapon blade/handle or monk glove/essence parts with tier/type filter dropdowns and weapon stat filtering.

nodes.name: StatFilterShared.svelte
nodes.summary: Shared stat-filter chip button with include/exclude state and a module-level buildStatMaps helper for label/color lookups.

nodes.name: elementalBoosts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines StatDef entries for the elemental boost stats (dexterity, physical, magic, elemental) plus their negative debuff variants.

nodes.name: filterActions.ts
nodes.summary: Creates include/exclude filter action handlers (toggle, remove, clear, chip keyboard) that mutate a FilterMap and notify subscribers.

nodes.name: Toast.svelte
nodes.summary: Fixed top-right toast notification container rendering toasts from the toast store with per-type styling and dismiss buttons.

nodes.name: Badge.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte 5 badge/pill component supporting size, shape, color, solid, mono, tag, and named variant props.

nodes.name: Button.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte 5 button component with variant (positive/negative/warning/info/neutral), size, and active-state props.

nodes.name: RollValue.svelte
nodes.summary: Animated value display that eases between numeric strings while preserving prefixes/suffixes and coloring negatives.

nodes.name: uiConstants.ts
nodes.summary: Shared UI constants: colors per damage type/tag/source/enchant rarity, source labels, and stat/tag label maps.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point that injects Vercel analytics and mounts the root App component into the DOM.

nodes.name: ModalSearchHeader.svelte
nodes.summary: Shared modal header composing a search input with suggestions, tag filter, stat/weapon-stat filter, and Highest/Most Effective/Brawny sort buttons.

nodes.name: getWADisplayName
nodes.summary: Returns the friendlier weapon-art display name when the build has the matching perk, otherwise returns the base name.

nodes.name: createFilterActions
nodes.summary: Builds include/exclude filter action handlers (toggle/remove/clear/keyboard) operating on a FilterMap with external state getters/setters.

nodes.name: trapFocus
nodes.summary: Traps Tab focus within the modal's focusable elements, cycling between first and last focusables.

nodes.name: buildStatMaps
nodes.summary: Builds label and color lookup Maps from stat groups for shared stat-filter chips.

nodes.name: computeItemEffectiveBoost
nodes.summary: Computes an item's effective boost as the sum of weapon scalings multiplied by matching stat values.

nodes.name: computeItemBrawnyBoost
nodes.summary: Computes effective boost after converting non-physical boosts into physical boost per the Brawny perk conversion rate.

nodes.name: updateDropdownPos
nodes.summary: Positions the enchant dropdown fixed relative to the trigger, flipping above when there is insufficient space below.

nodes.name: handleKeydown
nodes.summary: Handles dropdown keyboard navigation: open on Enter/Space, arrow-key highlighting, Escape to close, Enter to select.

nodes.name: handleScroll
nodes.summary: Re-positions the dropdown on scroll/resize using a requestAnimationFrame throttle.

nodes.name: animate
nodes.summary: Animates the numeric roll between two formatted values using eased rAF ticks while preserving prefix, suffix, and decimals.

nodes.name: MountIcon.svelte
nodes.summary: Inline SVG mount icon component that renders a detailed gradient-shaded mount silhouette built from dozens of path layers, scaled by a `size` prop and using a per-instance unique gradient ID so multiple icons render independently.

nodes.name: PropellingFunTracker.svelte
nodes.summary: Component for configuring the 'Propelling Fun' jump element (Air/Fire) and buff mode (Air only, Both, Fire only) through color-coded button groups and segmented range sliders, persisting choices into the shared `build` store via build.update.
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte with legacy $: reactive declarations deriving slider state from the build store

nodes.name: ScalingBreakdownRow.svelte
nodes.summary: Displays a single scaling-breakdown table row showing a stat's scaling value, boost percentage, and net contribution, formatting numeric values with roundMultiplier and treating boost keys found in PERCENT_STATS as percentage values.

nodes.name: StatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible stat filter panel with Positive/Negative tabs, include/exclude chip cycling via shared createFilterActions helpers, and sort-mode buttons (highest/lowest/alphabetical), dispatching filter maps and sort mode changes to the parent component.

nodes.name: SuggestDrop.svelte
nodes.summary: Dropdown that renders type-ahead suggestions for weapon names and perks, highlighting the query substring via highlightTextParts and dispatching a `select` event on mousedown so the input does not lose focus.

nodes.name: TagFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible tag filter panel grouping perk tags into Combat, Support, Status, Weapon Art/Rune, and Special categories with color-coded chips, an active-tag summary bar with per-tag removal, a clear-all action, and toggle/change events dispatched to the parent.

nodes.name: WeaponStatFilter.svelte
nodes.summary: Collapsible weapon-stat filter for Damage Type, Scaling, and Boost/Stats groups using include/exclude chips with DMG/SCL/STAT prefixes, and an exported matchesFilter predicate that tests weapon records against the active include/exclude map.

nodes.name: matchesFilter
nodes.summary: Exported predicate that returns true when an item's stats satisfy every active include/exclude filter entry, comparing stat values (> 0 for include, <= 0 for exclude) resolved from the item's stats map or top-level fields.

nodes.name: WeaponStatsDisplay.svelte
nodes.summary: Renders a weapon's stat block as grouped pills for damage types, scalings, and stat boosts, splitting the flat stats map by key suffix and formatting percentage-style stats (boost/defense/warding) with a % sign.

nodes.name: splitWeaponStats
nodes.summary: Partitions a flat weapon stats record into three arrays by key suffix: keys ending in 'Type' become damage types, keys ending in 'Scaling' become scalings, and everything else becomes boosts.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration that sets the app base path from VITE_BASE_PATH, wires the Svelte plugin, a PWA plugin (autoUpdate service worker with a StaleWhileRevalidate navigation cache), and a rollup bundle-size visualizer while disabling manual chunks.

nodes.name: buffs.ts
nodes.summary: Central constants module exporting 140 numeric values for buff and debuff potency, duration, and scaling, sourced from the game's BuffData. Covers potions, rune-granted buffs, weapon-art-granted buffs, perk-buff factory constants, potency modifiers, and generic debuff modifiers used by the damage calculation engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure data module: 140 exported UPPER_SNAKE_CASE const declarations, zero imports and zero functions, organized into commented sections that mirror the BuffData.ts definitions.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Central shared type definitions and constants for the damage engine, covering races, guilds, armor, rings, runes, enchantments, weapons, monk gear, build state, proc coefficients, boosts, and weapon hit data, plus helpers for upgrade scaling and proc checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of template-literal types (ScalingKey), keyof typeof lookups, and discriminated unions for game-data modeling.

nodes.name: applyUpgrade
nodes.summary: Scales a StatMap by an upgrade level using a compounding 1.1x multiplier per level, applying it multiplicatively for positive stats and inversely for negative stats.

nodes.name: canProc
nodes.summary: Determines whether a ProcCoefficient permits a proc by resolving its effective value and checking that it is greater than zero.

nodes.name: Boost.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the boost system for the damage calculator: exports BOOST_DEFS (damage/heal multiplier definitions keyed by perk) and BOOST_DEF_MAP lookup, the BoostContext/BoostDef interfaces, plus helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct and Penance bleed constants.
nodes.languageNotes: Data-driven design: declarative BOOST_DEFS entries combine simple multiplierPerPerk fields with optional calcFn callbacks for complex conditional boosts.

nodes.name: calcMinionAbsorptionPotency
nodes.summary: Calculates minion absorption potency by scaling MINION_ABSORPTION_MULT with summon boost percent and stack count, rounded to 4 decimals.

nodes.name: calcFrenzyPct
nodes.summary: Computes the Frenzy damage percentage from rage potency using FRENZY_BASE and the rage multiplier constant.

nodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the debuffs a build auto-applies from its active perks and combat conditions (Burn via Exhaust, Penance bleed, Weakening, Runic Blades, Hypnotist, HP-gated effects, and more) through getAutoDebuffs, with calcActualHpFillPct adjusting HP fill for negative protection.

nodes.name: calcActualHpFillPct
nodes.summary: Returns the actual HP fill percentage, translating negative protection into an effective max-HP increase so HP-gated debuffs evaluate correctly.

nodes.name: getAutoDebuffs
nodes.summary: Evaluates the full build state (perks, active buffs, proc coefficient, enemy HP) and returns the GrantedBuff[] list of debuffs the build automatically inflicts, deduplicating against existing buffs.

nodes.name: BuffData.ts
nodes.summary: Central data registry and computation module for Voxel Blade buffs and debuffs: defines the BUFF_DEFS metadata table and BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL, and provides the logic to assemble a build's active buffs, apply perk-based potency/duration modifiers, convert buff types, compute buff effects, and format perk descriptions.
nodes.languageNotes: Large data-driven TypeScript module using Record<string, BuffDefinition> lookups with dynamicDescription closures and a pipeline of buff transformation helpers.

nodes.name: getWeaponArtBuffs
nodes.summary: Returns the buff definitions granted by a weapon art, looked up by weapon art name from BUFF_DEFS.

nodes.name: getTrueBalanceBuffs
nodes.summary: Groups active debuffs by buff name and builds True Balance perk debuff definitions, applying the perk's potency/duration multipliers per debuff type and merging source labels.

nodes.name: getSpecificBuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies perk-specific potency and duration modifier formulas (e.g., mage rage, gladiatorial, Tailwind) to a buff definition when matching perks are present.

nodes.name: getBastionBlessBonus
nodes.summary: Computes the Bastion Bless buff bonus, scaling potency from the Bastion perk amount with a floor/rounding rule.

nodes.name: getGenericDebuffModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies generic debuff modifiers from perks (such as Endless Despair and Stored Corruption scaling) to a debuff definition's potency and duration.

nodes.name: getTricksterReflection
nodes.summary: Handles the Trickster reflection buff, folding in the warding debuff multiplier and perk-derived potency/duration modifiers.

nodes.name: applyBuffPerkModifiers
nodes.summary: Applies all perk-based potency and duration modifiers to a list of buffs, dispatching each buff to the specific, Bastion, Trickster, or generic modifier helpers and rounding results.

nodes.name: applyToxinTransferDuration
nodes.summary: Extends the duration of poison self-debuff stacks based on the Toxin Transfer perk.

nodes.name: convertTailwindToWhirlwind
nodes.summary: Converts Tailwind buffs into Whirlwind buff stacks using bounce duration multipliers and the Spirit Winds perk.

nodes.name: getBuffDescription
nodes.summary: Builds human-readable buff descriptions, interpolating computed potency, damage-reduction percentages, and dynamicDescription templates into the final text.

nodes.name: getPerkBuffs
nodes.summary: Iterates a build's active perk definitions and calls their buff factory functions to produce the corresponding buff entries.

nodes.name: getActiveBuildBuffs
nodes.summary: Collects the active buffs for a build, combining potion buffs with race-granted buffs.

nodes.name: applyCauterizeConversion
nodes.summary: Converts burn buffs into their cauterized (singed) variants when the Cauterize perk is active.

nodes.name: getBurnApplicationCount
nodes.summary: Counts the burn buff entries in a list, used by fire-application calculations.

nodes.name: assembleActiveBuffs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates full active-buff assembly for a build: weapon art buffs, perk buffs, potion/race buffs, Tailwind-to-Whirlwind and cauterize conversions, then perk modifier application.

nodes.name: calcBuffEffect
nodes.summary: Computes the numeric effect of a buff given its name and potency, applying effectPerTenthPotency scaling and rounding.

nodes.name: formatPerkDescription
nodes.summary: Substitutes a computed potency percentage into a perk description template string.

nodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
nodes.summary: Defines base-damage calculation helpers, HP-gate thresholds, and the PERK_DMG_DEFS registry for perk-based damage sources (springblast, bomber charge, ichor spark) used by the build damage engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Large data-driven TypeScript module: a lookup map of perk damage definitions plus small exported pure functions that compute base damage and gate thresholds.

nodes.name: gateThreshold
nodes.summary: Evaluates an HP-gate definition against a given perk amount and returns whether the gate threshold is met.

nodes.name: isHpGateActive
nodes.summary: Checks whether an HP-gate condition is currently active given the player's HP fill percentage and perk amount.

nodes.name: calcSpringblastBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes the base damage for the Springblast perk from its perk amount using the configured constants.

nodes.name: calcBomberChargeBaseDamage
nodes.summary: Computes Bomber Charge base damage, scaling from the perk amount and the percentage of missing HP (capped).

nodes.name: findPerkDmgDef
nodes.summary: Looks up a perk damage definition from the PERK_DMG_DEFS registry by perk name and optional label, falling back to a linear scan.

nodes.name: utils.ts
nodes.summary: Provides shared math, text-highlighting, and proc-chance utility helpers used across the damage engine and UI, including multiplier rounding, scaling factors, warding debuff multipliers, search highlighting, and proc chance computation.
nodes.languageNotes: Mostly pure functions with a type-only import; several helpers rely on percent-to-multiplier conventions shared with the engine.

nodes.name: roundMultiplier
nodes.summary: Rounds a damage multiplier to 4 decimal places to keep downstream engine calculations stable.

nodes.name: applyScalingMult
nodes.summary: Converts an effective fraction into a multiplicative scaling factor, using reciprocal scaling for negative values.

nodes.name: scalingEq
nodes.summary: Formats a percentage as a human-readable scaling equation string for UI display.

nodes.name: calcWardingDebuffMultiplier
nodes.summary: Computes the damage multiplier from a warding debuff value, using reciprocal scaling for positive warding and subtractive scaling for negative warding.

nodes.name: highlightText
nodes.summary: Returns HTML with case-insensitive query matches wrapped in <mark> tags for modal search highlighting, escaping all output.

nodes.name: highlightTextParts
nodes.summary: Splits text into segments with a boolean highlight flag per query match, used for structured search result display.

nodes.name: calcProcChance
nodes.summary: Pure utility that computes the effective proc chance of an effect from its base chance, hit proc coefficient, and scaling type.

nodes.name: stats.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained Rollup Visualizer HTML report (generated build artifact) showing the Voxel Blade production bundle's size distribution as an interactive treemap, with embedded compiled rendering code and inline module-tree data.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-file artifact bundling a minified preact-compatible VDOM renderer with d3 hierarchy/treemap layout, plus an inline JSON tree of the rolldown output modules; SVG is produced at runtime rather than in markup.

nodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.summary: Core per-hit damage calculation component. Receives weapon hits, typed boosts, debuffs, crit values, enemy defenses, and DoT data as props, then computes final damage per hit type by applying armor penetration, damage-type multipliers, debuff effects, crits, and heal sources. Renders the computed hit breakdown with badges and tooltips.
nodes.languageNotes: Large Svelte 5 component (2812 lines) using legacy `export let` props; damage math lives in `$:` reactive blocks and internal helper functions.

nodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
nodes.summary: Main damage analysis screen. Assembles active buffs/debuffs from the build store, resolves weapon/weapon-art/rune/mount-damage scalings and damage-type conversions, computes DoT ticks, self-damage perks, and defensive sources, then feeds computed hits into the BaseDamageCalc engine. Renders scaling breakdowns, per-hit rows, and toggle controls for boosts, buffs, and effects.
nodes.languageNotes: Massive Svelte 5 component (7560 lines) with dozens of `$:` reactive derived blocks and IIFEs computing derived values.

nodes.name: boosts.ts
nodes.summary: Pure constant module exporting 64 named numeric boost multipliers used across the damage engine, covering frenzy, minion absorption, lifesteal, per-stack perk multipliers, Heat Drill, and Essence Ray tuning values.
nodes.languageNotes: Barrel of exported constants with no functions or classes; grouped by perk categories via comments.

nodes.name: resolveTypeInfo
nodes.summary: Resolves a single damage-type key into its metadata, applicable typed boosts, debuff multipliers, and armor-mitigated multiplier, producing the final per-type damage entry used to assemble each hit's typed breakdown.

nodes.name: loadDefenses
nodes.summary: Loads saved enemy defense values per damage type from localStorage, falling back to zeroed defaults when the value is missing or unparseable.

nodes.name: rebuildDefensesFromPresets
nodes.summary: Recomputes the enemy defense map by summing defense values contributed by all active daily-challenge presets.

nodes.name: calcDebuffTypeDamageMult
nodes.summary: Builds a map of per-damage-type multipliers by multiplying type-specific damage multipliers from active, non-disabled debuffs.

nodes.name: calcDebuffTypeLabels
nodes.summary: Collects the debuff names that modify each damage type for display in the breakdown UI.

nodes.name: calcEffectiveDefenses
nodes.summary: Applies debuff defense reductions (e.g. Shatter armor stripping) to base enemy defenses, returning the effective per-damage-type defense map.

nodes.name: calcArmorMult
nodes.summary: Computes the armor damage multiplier from defense percentage and penetration, using a low-armor branch when penetration exceeds defense and a high-armor branch otherwise; true and summon damage bypass armor entirely.

nodes.name: computePreMitigationBase
nodes.summary: Computes the pre-mitigation base damage of a hit by summing base damage times its type multipliers, then applying scaling, combat, and weapon-boost multipliers.

nodes.name: getApplicableBoosts
nodes.summary: Looks up the pre-built per-type boost index and returns applicable perk boosts for a damage type and group, filtering by group applicability and proc-coefficient requirements.

nodes.name: hitTypeSum
nodes.summary: Sums the raw or crit damage values of a computed hit's types, honoring per-group activation divisors and once-per-group flags.

nodes.name: groupTotalSum
nodes.summary: Totals damage across a list of computed hits, treating M1/M2 group hits as single events while honoring per-hit proc counts.

nodes.name: onOutside
nodes.summary: Outside-click handler that closes an open panel when the click target is not inside the referenced element.

nodes.name: computeActiveDefensivePerkSources
nodes.summary: Resolves active defensive perk sources (protection, adaptive plate, darkness gating, mount, debuff count) and scales their defense percentages by the defensive potency multiplier when Draconic infusion or color modifiers apply.

nodes.name: dotScalingMult
nodes.summary: Computes the effective DoT scaling multiplier for a damage-over-time type by summing per-stat scaling contributions and applying the scaling equation.

nodes.name: toggleBuffKey
nodes.summary: Toggles a buff's disabled state by its source key, syncing linked boosts, and persists the change to the build store.

nodes.name: toggleBuffByName
nodes.summary: Toggles all sources of a buff by name, syncing linked boosts, and persists the change to the build store.

nodes.name: toggleBoost
nodes.summary: Toggles a damage boost's disabled state and propagates the change to linked buff keys in the build store.

nodes.name: seqWithTypes
nodes.summary: Expands a hit sequence into per-hit damage entries by applying damage-type multipliers, rage multipliers on affected types, and scaling/combat multipliers, producing a typed hit breakdown for display.

nodes.name: _resolveHitDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Parses a hit's damage-type string (e.g. "Same as weapon" or "1.2 Physical") into a typed map and applies damage-type bonuses.

nodes.name: _resolveHitDmgTypesBase
nodes.summary: Parses a hit's damage-type string into a typed map without applying damage-type bonuses, yielding the base unmodified types.

nodes.name: cycleLightningState
nodes.summary: Cycles the Lightning Cloak state through off/third/twoThirds and disables the corresponding buff keys when turned off.

nodes.name: buildScalingRows
nodes.summary: Builds display rows for a scaling map, computing each stat's contribution from the build's boost stats and assigning row colors.

nodes.name: parseWAHitsAll
nodes.summary: Parses a weapon-art's "Damage (n×x)" description string into an array of per-hit damage and heal amounts.

nodes.name: parseRangeDamage
nodes.summary: Parses a min-max range damage string with optional per-end labels into a structured {min, minLabel, max, maxLabel} result.

nodes.name: applyWeaponCharge
nodes.summary: Applies the current weapon charge percentage as a multiplier to a base damage value.

nodes.name: _computePerkScalingMult
nodes.summary: Computes a perk's scaling multiplier from a scaling definition map by summing stat contributions (percent stats divided by 100) and applying the scaling equation.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the real documentation, not the README: AGENTS.md explains the voxlblade-builder stack (Svelte 5 + Vite + TypeScript, pnpm, Vitest), while docs/ONBOARDING.md is the genuine architecture guide — it maps the config/source/data/engine/modal/store layers and walks through the damage-calculation pipeline. Note that README.md is only the stock create-vite Svelte template and says nothing about this project's actual purpose: a web damage calculator and build optimizer for the Roblox game Voxel Blade. This tour follows ONBOARDING's layer map: overview, entry, UI orchestration, damage computation, game data, engine, then config and deployment.

tour.title: Application Entry & Mount
tour.description: index.html is the real browser entry: it loads the Svelte app into the #app container. src/main.ts then mounts the root App component and injects Vercel analytics, while src/app.css defines the dark-theme design tokens (colors, surfaces, radii, shadows, draconic theme variables) consumed by every component. This is the one place the app boots — everything else hangs off the App component mounted here.
tour.languageLesson: Svelte 5 uses the `mount(App, { target })` API (imported from 'svelte') instead of the legacy `new App({ target })`. Styling is driven by CSS custom properties (design tokens), so the whole theme can shift by overriding a handful of variables on :root.

tour.title: Root Orchestration & Build State
tour.description: src/App.svelte is the root orchestration component and the largest file in the app (~7,560 lines): it owns the build-state editors for race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon, and enchantment selection (with drag-and-drop), and wires together the damage analyzer, buff list, level bar, emotional tracker, and build saves from the previous step. Its counterpart src/lib/store.ts centralizes reactive state: writable/derived stores with debounced localStorage persistence and mutation actions, where the derived result store reruns calcBuild live so damage output updates as you edit the build. This is where the UI connects to the calculation engine.
tour.languageLesson: Svelte 5 runes: `$state` declares reactive variables and `$derived` declares computed values that automatically re-run when their inputs change. Derived Svelte stores behave the same way — the result store recomputes calcBuild on every build mutation, giving 'live' damage numbers.

tour.title: Shared Domain Types & Math Utils
tour.description: These are the foundations everything else imports. src/lib/types.ts has the highest fan-in in the project (20 importers) because it defines the central shared types and constants for the damage engine — races, guilds, armor, rings, runes, enchantments, weapons, monk gear, build state, and weapon hit data. src/lib/utils.ts supplies the shared math, text-highlighting, and proc-chance helpers used across engine and UI, and src/lib/engine/_utils.ts provides the tiny round2/round4 helpers that keep floating-point results consistent. Understanding these contracts first makes every engine and data module easier to read.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript: this codebase leans on large shared interface/union contracts (types.ts) as the single vocabulary shared between data, engine, and UI layers. It also uses small pure math helpers (round2/round4) instead of ad-hoc Number.toFixed calls to avoid float-precision drift across many sequential calculations.

tour.title: Main Analysis Screen
tour.description: src/DamageAnalyzer.svelte is the main build-analysis screen: it reads the build store, assembles active buffs and debuffs, resolves weapon/weapon-art/rune/mount damage scalings and damage-type conversions, computes DoT ticks, self-damage perks, and defensive sources, then feeds the computed hits into the per-hit engine from the next step. Around it, small control components feed state in: BuffList.svelte manages the active buff/debuff list with warding multipliers, LevelBar.svelte edits level and HP fill (computing effective max HP from protection), and EmotionalTracker.svelte selects the character's emotional state. Together they implement the 'inputs' of the calculator whose outputs you'll see next.

tour.title: Per-Hit Damage Computation
tour.description: This is the heart of the calculator. src/BaseDamageCalc.svelte receives weapon hits, typed boosts, debuffs, crit values, enemy defenses, and DoT data as props, then computes final damage per hit by applying armor penetration, damage-type multipliers, debuff effects, crits, and heal sources — and renders the breakdown with badges and tooltips. The prop interfaces come from src/lib/dmgTypes.ts (ComputedType, PerkOnHitDmg, ComputedHit plus badge display metadata), and src/DmgTotalTooltip.svelte renders the animated per-hit breakdown pie chart. This step converts all the state you've seen so far into concrete numbers.

tour.title: Weapon Part Databases
tour.description: Moving from code to content: the weapon system is data-driven. src/data/blades.json catalogues blade heads across tiers 1-5 (attack speed, damage-type weights, scaling coefficients, blade type, perks), src/data/handles.json does the same for Medium/Long Handle and Pole parts, and src/data/gloves.json and src/data/essences.json cover the monk weapon paths (gloves plus essence variants). The engine's weapon module (later in the tour) consumes these via name-keyed lookups, so adding a new weapon is a data change, not a code change.
tour.languageLesson: JSON as game data: these files are schema-less arrays of objects, so correctness depends on convention rather than a compiler. The engine builds index maps (e.g. getBlade/getHandle/getGlove/getEssence) keyed by item name and relies on consistent field shapes across every entry.

tour.title: Gear & Character Databases
tour.description: The rest of the equipable and character data lives here. src/data/armors.json defines armor sets with shared stat blocks, attached perks, and their Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings parts; src/data/rings.json and src/data/runes.json define equippable rings and active ability runes; and src/data/races.json plus src/data/guilds.json define the ten races' passives and the guilds with their three progression ranks and per-rank bonuses. The equipment and character engine data modules (from the engine barrel) load these registries, so every build in App.svelte resolves back to these files.

tour.title: Data Modules: Buffs, Boosts & Perk Damage
tour.description: Not all game data is JSON — several subsystems ship as TypeScript data+logic modules. src/data/BuffData.ts is the central registry and computation module for buffs/debuffs (BUFF_DEFS metadata, the debuff pool, and the logic to assemble a build's active buffs and compute their effects). src/data/Boost.ts defines the damage/heal boost system (BOOST_DEFS keyed by perk), src/data/Perkbasedmg.ts registers perk-based damage sources like springblast and bomber charge, and src/data/statboost.ts mutates a StatMap in a fixed execution order to apply perk stat boosts. These mirror the JSON layer of Step 7-8 but add the calculation logic that static data can't express.

tour.title: Engine Build Pipeline
tour.description: src/lib/engine/build.ts is the core pipeline (highest fan-out in the project): it accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots, finalizes perks, computes CDR, boosts, crit, buffs, and weapon results, and returns the assembled BuildResult via calcBuild — the function the result store calls live. It composes the weapon module (merging blade/handle or glove/essence data, applying shrine and monk-rank bonuses), the enchant module (stat transformations, upgrades, infusion, exclusive-slot rules), and the shrine module (tier multipliers on weapon part stats). The src/lib/engine.ts barrel re-exports all of this as the public engine API consumed by the UI.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript: the engine is built as a pipeline of pure functions — each module (shrine → weapon → enchant → build) takes structured inputs and returns structured outputs, composed by build.ts into a single BuildResult. This separation keeps the complex damage math unit-testable.

tour.title: Engine Helpers: Crit, Defense & Damage Types
tour.description: Three specialist modules do the subtler math. src/lib/crit.ts computes natural/extra crit chance, proc-coefficient-scaled chances, and crit damage multipliers from perks (Dexterity, Thief Training, Venom Eater) including Primal gating and full breakdown reporting. src/lib/defense.ts resolves defense sources into flat and percent multipliers, converting them into effective damage multipliers and true DR percentages. src/lib/damageTypeResolve.ts resolves final damage-type distributions — merging weapon-art damage types with bonuses and applying conversions like Fire-Air (Echo Incineration) — guided by the canonical type metadata in src/lib/constants/damage-types.ts (labels, colors, inheritance rules, priority ordering). These feed directly into BaseDamageCalc from Step 6.

tour.title: Balance Constants & Tuning
tour.description: Every magic number in the game is centralized under src/lib/constants/. The constants.ts barrel re-exports all submodules (second-highest fan-in), while perks.ts catalogs ~60 perk-mechanic tuning values, buffs.ts exports 140 buff/debuff potency, duration, and scaling numbers sourced from the game, boosts.ts holds 64 named boost multipliers, and game.ts is the single source of truth for core constants like max level and the base HP formula. Keeping balance tuning in one place means game updates are data edits, and the engine stays mechanical.

tour.title: UI Primitives & Selection Modals
tour.description: The app's UI is built from reusable Svelte components rather than inline markup. src/lib/Modal.svelte provides the accessible modal shell (overlay, focus trapping) used by every selection dialog, src/lib/ModalSearchHeader.svelte composes search input, tag/stat filters, and sort buttons for the item pickers, and src/lib/ui/Badge.svelte is the shared pill component for tags and stat chips. The src/lib/modals/index.ts barrel re-exports the four selection modals (Race, Guild, Accessory, WeaponPart). These are the building blocks that keep the huge App.svelte and DamageAnalyzer.svelte components from becoming unmaintainable.

tour.title: Configuration, CI & Deployment
tour.description: Wrapping up with how the project is configured, built, and shipped. config:package.json declares the scripts (dev, build, check, test) and the Svelte 5 + Vite + Vitest toolchain; file:vite.config.ts wires the Svelte plugin, a PWA service worker, and a bundle visualizer; config:tsconfig.app.json sets the strict app-level TypeScript checking. Deployment is dual-path: config:vercel.json serves the static build on Vercel with cache headers, while the GitHub Actions pipeline builds and publishes ./dist to GitHub Pages on pushes to main. Understanding these files explains how the SPA from Step 2 reaches players.
tour.languageLesson: YAML (GitHub Actions): the workflow is structured as an `on` trigger, a `jobs` section, and ordered `steps` (checkout → install → build → deploy). `actions/configure-pages` plus the Pages artifact/deploy actions handle publishing the built ./dist directory to GitHub Pages.
